sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: Repair TRF-048 by enforcing the explicit bracket-exclusion semantics: add owner-local constraints for supplied nltl:grossFrameShearArea and nltl:bracketArea (QUDT QuantityValue, decimal numeric value, unit:CentiM2) and a bounded formula constraint that ties nltl:actualFrameShearArea to gross area less bracket area; do not merely equate actual area to the calculated A value while omitting the bracket relationship. Bind nltl:longitudinalFrameShearFactorF5 and its numeric value in the formula query and use that operand in expectedA rather than the disconnected literal 2.16, while retaining the exact inclusive 2.16 constraint on f5. Eliminate the accidental pass from FILTER excluding zero denominators: constrain spacing, yieldStrength, and frameMomentFactorM numeric values to valid positive values (or explicitly report invalid denominators) so the formula check is never silently skipped.
